entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A gothic plane beset by Emrakul's corruption, vampires, werewolves, geists and ghouls.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The angel who guarded Innistrad; she emerged from the Helvault, cleansed the world with the Cursemute, then fell to madness and was unmade.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: A silver monolith that imprisoned Avacyn until it was shattered by a golden helix.

entities.name: Cursemute
entities.description: A wave of spells in which Avacyn cleansed the world with divine fire, ending with werewolf howls and the start of her madness.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: An Eldrazi whose visions and murmurs warp Innistrad, imprisoned in the moon.

entities.name: Bruna
entities.description: A fallen angel (Bruna, the Fading Light) who now sees only Emrakul's visions.

entities.name: Gisela
entities.description: A fallen angel (Gisela, the Broken Blade) who now hears only Emrakul's murmurs.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: An angel who wept on discovering what became of her sisters.

entities.name: Brisela
entities.description: The merged horror of Bruna and Gisela, voice of nightmares.

entities.name: Thalia
entities.description: A Knight-Cathar and Guardian of Thraben who speaks of Avacyn's ideals and the Lunarch Council.

entities.name: Odric
entities.description: A cathar who took no joy in violence but saved lives.

entities.name: Manfried Ulmach
entities.description: The Chief Inquisitor who values boons from angels.

entities.name: Ludevic
entities.description: A necro-alchemist whose notes record Geralf's growing prowess.

entities.name: Geralf
entities.description: A stitcher who rivals and works with Ludevic and is Gisa's brother.

entities.name: Gisa
entities.description: A ghoulcaller and sister of Geralf.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker necromancer who boasts of her power above Innistrad's ghoulcallers.

entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: A demon freed with Avacyn from the Helvault whom the Skirsdag worshiped.

entities.name: Ormendahl
entities.description: A demon who claimed the Skirsdag's devotion after Griselbrand was gone.

entities.name: Anje Falkenrath
entities.description: A Falkenrath vampire who speaks of the first night's feast.

entities.name: Uta Falkenrath
entities.description: A Falkenrath vampire who likes a living viper.

entities.name: Vanya Falkenrath
entities.description: A painter admired for her crimson hues.

entities.name: Stefan
entities.description: An art critic.

entities.name: Ulrich
entities.description: A Krallenhorde alpha who says he is of the same pack.

entities.name: Rahilda
entities.description: A Vildin-Pack alpha who says it is right to fear what you keep locked away.

entities.name: Alena
entities.description: A Kessig trapper who fears what will reply to a chilling howl.

entities.name: Raf Gyel
entities.description: A member of the Quiver of Kessig.

entities.name: Old Rutstein
entities.description: A merchant whose axes and wares were not wanted.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A figure whose journal entry 434 notes more to Avacyn's madness.

entities.name: Runo Stromkirk
entities.description: A Stromkirk who reveres the sea's ancient power.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker who says Impressive.

entities.name: Grete
entities.description: A cathar apostate.

entities.name: Mikaeus
entities.description: A writer whose writings say faith can quicken stones.

entities.name: Kordel the Cryptic
entities.description: A figure who says tomorrow wears yesterday's face.

entities.name: Zilky Grebbs
entities.description: A self-styled Doctor who says nature creates nothing unnatural.

entities.name: Emili
entities.description: A guard captain.

entities.name: Enslow
entities.description: A ghoulcaller of Nephalia.

entities.name: Higa
entities.description: A slayer-captain of Gatstaf.

entities.name: Paulin
entities.description: A trapper of Somberwald.

entities.name: Sved
entities.description: A fisherman of Nephalia.

entities.name: Radwick
entities.description: A farmer of Gatstaf.

entities.name: Adin
entities.description: A Moorland villager.

entities.name: Beltstad
entities.description: A cathar recruit.

entities.name: Cosper Lowe
entities.description: A member of the Silbern Guard.

entities.name: Garner Kroft
entities.description: A Moorland farmer who took a twisted stone.

entities.name: Kep
entities.description: A Lunarch inquisitor.

entities.name: Jenrik
entities.description: The owner of a tower served by geists.

entities.name: Otto the Hunter
entities.description: A hunter eaten by a snake.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: Home of a cathedral that must stand; where cathars and inspectors serve.

entities.name: Gavony
entities.description: A province whose rider forces and ditch sayings are known.

entities.name: Kessig
entities.description: A province with narrow ravines where howlpacks hunt.

entities.name: Stensia
entities.description: A mountainous province.

entities.name: Nephalia
entities.description: A coastal region where malign spirits and inventors are plentiful.

entities.name: Geier Reach
entities.description: A mountainous region with passes.

entities.name: Estwald
entities.description: A werewolf-infested region.

entities.name: Hanweir
entities.description: A town with a garrison and a watchkeep.

entities.name: Avabruck
entities.description: A town with a mayor hiding his true nature.

entities.name: Cathars
entities.description: Avacyn's holy warriors who defend Innistrad, some despairing at her unmaking.

entities.name: Skirsdag
entities.description: A cult of demon worshipers.

entities.name: Quietus Cult
entities.description: A cult that seeks wisdom from the dead.

entities.name: Gavony Riders
entities.description: Mounted defenders of Gavony.

entities.name: Silbern Guard
entities.description: A guard force.

entities.name: Lunarch Council
entities.description: The ruling council whose salvation Thalia disclaims.

entities.name: Voldaren
entities.description: A vampire bloodline.

entities.name: Falkenrath
entities.description: A vampire bloodline of bloodlust.

entities.name: Markov
entities.description: A vampire bloodline.

entities.name: Stromkirk
entities.description: A vampire family that prizes silence.

entities.name: Geists
entities.description: Restless spirits of the dead who help or harm the living.

entities.name: Werewolves
entities.description: Beasts of Innistrad whose attacks increased and whose howls ended the Cursemute.

entities.name: Flight of Nightmares
entities.description: A horde formed from the collapsed remnants of Innistrad's corrupted angelic hosts.

events.summary: Some cathars despair at Avacyn's unmaking while others redouble their efforts.
events.quote: Some cathars succumbed to despair at Avacyn's unmaking.

events.summary: Sigarda weeps on discovering what became of her sisters.
events.quote: Upon discovering what had become of her sisters, Sigarda could only weep.

events.summary: Bruna now sees only Emrakul's visions.
events.quote: She now sees only Emrakul's visions.

events.summary: Gisela now hears only Emrakul's murmurs.
events.quote: She now hears only Emrakul's murmurs.

events.summary: Emrakul is imprisoned in the moon.
events.quote: Only one vault was great enough to hold Emrakul.

events.summary: Avacyn emerges free from the shattered Helvault.
events.quote: Avacyn emerged, free from her prison at last.

events.summary: Avacyn emerges from the broken Helvault but her freedom comes with Griselbrand.
events.quote: Avacyn emerged from the broken Helvault, but her freedom came at a price

events.summary: Avacyn cleanses the world with divine fire in the Cursemute.
events.quote: In a wave of spells called the Cursemute, Avacyn cleansed the world with divine fire.

events.summary: Werewolf howls announce the end of the Cursemute and the beginning of Avacyn's madness.
events.quote: announced the end of the Cursemute

events.summary: The Skirsdag take Ormendahl as their demon after Griselbrand is gone.
events.quote: Ormendahl did not make them wait long.

events.summary: Corrupted angelic hosts collapse into the Flight of Nightmares.
events.quote: collapsed to form the Flight of Nightmares.

events.summary: A woman saves her town from a howlpack at the cost of her life and becomes a geist.
events.quote: She faced down a howlpack alone, saving her town at the cost of her life.

events.summary: Grete denounces the fallen Avacyn as no longer their guardian.
events.quote: She is our guardian no longer.

events.summary: Ludevic's notes record Geralf's growing prowess.
Gisa chides her brother Geralf for sharing his toys with Ludevic.
events.quote: I too have found some new playmates.

events.summary: The Skirsdag await a new demon after Griselbrand departs.
events.quote: With Griselbrand gone, the Skirsdag eagerly awaited another demon

events.summary: Tamiyo records that there is more to Avacyn's madness.

relations.note: Gisa addresses Geralf as brother and he addresses her as sister.
relations.quote: Dear brother, it's sweet that you have chosen to share your toys with Ludevic

relations.note: Sigarda weeps over her sisters' fate.
relations.quote: Upon discovering what had become of her sisters

relations.note: The cathars are Avacyn's holy warriors.
relations.quote: Avacyn's holy warriors kept hope alive in her darkest hours.

relations.note: The Skirsdag devoted themselves to Griselbrand and then to Ormendahl.
relations.quote: With Griselbrand gone, the Skirsdag eagerly awaited another demon to claim their devotion.
Ormendahl did not make them wait long.
She now sees only Emrakul's visions.
